jobs_results.description:
About Northern Trust

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

Position Summary

Northern Trust is seeking an experienced AI Full Stack Cloud Engineer to design, build, deploy, and support enterprise AI solutions across the Digital Coworkers ecosystem and Generative AI Foundation Platform (GAI). This role combines full stack application development, cloud engineering, AI integration, platform engineering, and enterprise solution delivery. The successful candidate will develop scalable, secure, and governed AI-powered business solutions leveraging cloud-native technologies, large language models, enterprise APIs, workflow automation capabilities, and Digital Coworker frameworks. The individual will work closely with AI Engineers, Cloud Engineers, Product Managers, Technical Account Managers, Architects, Scrum Masters, and business stakeholders to accelerate AI adoption and deliver measurable business value across Northern Trust.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Primary Responsibilities

Full Stack Application Development

Design and develop full stack applications supporting Digital Coworkers and GAI platform capabilities.Build modern web applications, APIs, microservices, and enterprise integration services.Develop reusable software components supporting multiple AI-driven products and business domains.Create scalable user experiences that simplify enterprise AI adoption and workflow automation.Participate in architecture reviews, code reviews, and technical design discussions.GAI Foundation Platform & Digital Coworker Engineering

Build AI-powered business solutions leveraging the Generative AI Foundation Platform.Develop and support Digital Coworkers across Transfer Agency, Reconciliation, Omnium, and future AI business initiatives.Integrate AI services, enterprise APIs, workflow orchestration platforms, and cloud-native services.Support production deployment, monitoring, scalability, reliability, and operational readiness.Collaborate with AI Engineers and platform teams to deliver enterprise-ready AI capabilities.AI Engineering & Platform Integration

Integrate applications with Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) solutions, AI agents, and orchestration frameworks.Develop enterprise AI integrations using approved AI services and AI platform capabilities.Support AI lifecycle activities including testing, deployment, monitoring, governance, and operational readiness.Contribute to responsible AI and enterprise AI governance initiatives.Partner with business and technology teams to identify opportunities for AI-enabled transformation.Cloud Engineering & Infrastructure

Design and deploy cloud-native solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure services.Develop Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and related automation frameworks.Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines supporting enterprise application delivery.Implement monitoring, logging, resiliency, and performance optimization practices.Support secure and governed cloud engineering standards.Engineering Excellence

Promote software engineering best practices, coding standards, and reusable architecture patterns.Develop technical documentation, deployment guides, operational runbooks, and support procedures.Support continuous improvement initiatives across engineering and delivery teams.Work independently while effectively collaborating across multiple functions and organizations.Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Software Development, or a related discipline; equivalent professional experience will be considered.7+ years of software engineering experience supporting enterprise applications.5+ years of cloud engineering experience supporting Azure or comparable cloud platforms.Demonstrated experience designing and developing APIs, microservices, and distributed systems.Experience building enterprise applications using modern software engineering practices.Strong experience collaborating across engineering, architecture, operations, security, and business teams.Strong written and verbal communication skills.Ability to operate effectively in a regulated enterprise environment with governance, controls, auditability, and operational readiness expectations.Experience working independently while managing multiple priorities and deliverables.Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Northern Trust will not sponsor applicants for U.S. work visa status for this opportunity (no sponsorship is available for H-1B, L-1, TN, O-1, E-3, H-1B1, F-1, J-1, OPT, CPT or any other employment-based visa)

Technical Knowledge & Tools

Technical / Domain Knowledge

Delivery & Collaboration Tools

Full stack application development; cloud engineering; Azure services; Infrastructure as Code (Terraform); CI/CD; distributed systems; microservices; API development; AI/ML concepts; LLMs; RAG; AI agents; vector databases; prompt engineering; digital coworkers; workflow automation; platform integrations; enterprise security and controls.

Azure DevOps, GitHub, Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Teams, ServiceNow, Terraform, Power BI, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring platforms, release management tools, API management platforms, and operational support tooling.

Preferred Qualifications

Experience supporting enterprise AI platforms and AI-enabled business solutions.Experience building AI-powered applications using Microsoft AI services.Experience supporting Digital Coworkers, intelligent automation platforms, or workflow orchestration solutions.Experience integrating Azure OpenAI, Copilot technologies, AI services, or agentic AI solutions.Experience within financial services or another regulated industry.Familiarity with enterprise AI governance, Responsible AI, model lifecycle management, and operational controls.Experience supporting globally distributed engineering teams.Experience leveraging Snowflake, Databricks, vector databases, and enterprise integration platforms.Experience integrating with ServiceNow, Identity Management systems, and operational support processes.Leadership Competencies

Technical curiosity and continuous learning

Executive presence and concise communication

Systems thinking and architectural mindset

Strong collaboration across business and technology

Problem solving and analytical thinking

Innovation and creative solution development

Ownership mindset and accountability

Influencing without authority

Engineering excellence and quality focus

Delivery discipline and operational readiness

Role Impact

This role is designed to help the Digital Coworkers and GAI Foundation Platform teams scale enterprise AI delivery through secure software engineering, cloud-native architecture, AI integration, and platform innovation. The successful candidate will help transform AI strategy into production-ready business capabilities while reinforcing scalability, reliability, governance, operational excellence, and measurable business value.

Equal Employment Opportunity Statement

Northern Trust is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work performed and is not an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties, or skills required. Responsibilities may evolve based on business needs.

Salary Range:

$137,400 - 233,600 USD

Salary range is a good faith estimate of base pay. Northern Trust provides a comprehensive benefits package including retirement benefits (401k and pension), health and welfare benefits (medical, dental, vision, spending accounts and disability), paid time off, parental and caregiver leave, life & accident insurance, and other voluntary and well-being benefits. Northern Trust also provides a discretionary bonus program that may include an equity component.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the U.S. without the need for employment-based visa sponsorship now or in the future. Working with Us

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

Reasonable Accommodation

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

Principal Innovation Developer – Cloud & AI

  







This role has been designed as 'Hybrid' with a requirement that you will work on average 2 days per week from an HPE office.



Who We Are:

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.





Job Description:

   

This role has been designed as “Hybrid” with an expectation that you will work on average 2-3 days per week from an HPE office.


Who We AreHewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We value diverse backgrounds and succeed together. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career, our culture will embrace you. 


About the RoleAs an Innovation Engineer in the Hybrid Cloud CTO organization, you will play a senior individual contributor role responsible for driving complex, high-impact incubation projects across AI, cloud-native architectures, and emerging software technologies. Working alongside technical leads and cross-functional partners, you will design, implement, and validate advanced solutions that accelerate HPE’s transformation and deliver innovative capabilities to internal teams and external customers.


You will apply deep expertise in distributed systems, Generative AI, microservices, and cloud technologies to create robust, scalable, and secure services.  This role demands the ability to blend hands‑on development with architectural leadership, proactively generate and advance innovative concepts, and uphold technical excellence across a diverse portfolio of projects.


Primary Responsibilities· Serve as a senior technical contributor on complex AI and cloud-native incubation projects, owning design and implementation of key components.

·  Lead teams of up to 5-6 engineers of multiple disciplines through the full lifecycle of concept development while collaborating with multiple stakeholders.

· Evaluate and integrate emerging software technologies, including Generative AI frameworks (LLMs, RAG, LangGraph, Knowledge Graphs, ADK, A2A).

· Design, build, and validate microservices and cloud-native systems deployed across public cloud, datacenter, and edge environments.

· Contribute to technical architecture decisions, ensuring solutions meet requirements for scale, performance, security, and reliability.

· Collaborate closely with internal customers, technical leads, and business stakeholders to align emerging technologies with strategic objectives.

· Conduct research spikes, proofs-of-concept, and experiments that evaluate feasibility and technical trade-offs.

· Implement high-quality code following best practices in AI assisted code generation (GitHub CoPilot), testing, validation, CI/CD, and observability.

· Provide mentorship and knowledge-sharing to team members of all levels  on advanced software and AI topics.

· Work effectively across multiple parallel projects in a dynamic environment with frequent context switching.


Education and Experience· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, AI/ML, or related technical field.

· Typically 10-15 years of software development experience, with at least 3-5 years focused on cloud-native and AI/ML systems.


Required Knowledge and Skills· Strong programming proficiency in Python and experience with ML libraries (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Transformers).

· Deep understanding of distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

· Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, REST APIs, and cloud-native application development.

· Experience implementing Generative AI solutions using LLMs, RAG, LangGraph, or similar frameworks.

· Working knowledge of multiple technologies to include vector databases, graph, NOSQL and RDBMS systems

· Experience deploying cloud solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

· Strong understanding of AI Governance and Security alignment, and responsible AI principles.

· Proficiency in Agile development methodologies, including Scrum or Kanban.

· Experience contributing to large-scale cloud service development environments.


Preferred Knowledge and Experience· Experience with multi-agent systems and agent orchestration frameworks.

· Knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) server development.

· Understanding of Google ADK and A2A protocol implementations.

· Knowledge graph design, construction, and querying.

· Familiarity with ML Ops tools (MLflow, Weights & Biases, LangSmith).

· Experience with observability platforms like Prometheus, Grafana, or OpenTelemetry.





Accessibility


HPE is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace and encourages applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities. If you believe you require accommodation during any stage of the application or interview process, please submit your request by completing our secure form linked here.


Note: This option is reserved for applicants needing assistance/reasonable accommodation related to a disability.





What We Can Offer You:

Health & Wellbeing

We strive to provide our team members and their loved ones with a comprehensive suite of benefits that supports their physical, financial and emotional wellbeing.



Personal & Professional Development

We also invest in your career because the better you are, the better we all are. We have specific programs catered to helping you reach any career goals you have — whether you want to become a knowledge expert in your field or apply your skills to another division.



Unconditional Inclusion

We are unconditionally inclusive in the way we work and celebrate individual uniqueness. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good.





Let's Stay Connected:

Follow @HPECareers on Instagram to see the latest on people, culture and tech at HPE.

items: The AI/ML Engineer serves in a part-time, 1099 independent contractor capacity and is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and artificial intelligence solutions that drive Steel Point's data-driven initiatives

jobs_results.description:
Steel Point Solutions is an amazing SBA Certified (8a), HUBZone, Small Disadvantaged Business (SDB) and a Woman Owned Small Business (WOSB) company. Established in 2013 with a vision of offering world class, integrated business solutions for all levels of Government and commercial enterprises. We are represented by a team of talented and qualified professionals who know how essential efficient, cost-effective integrated solutions are to your organization's success. Leveraging these resources, we strive daily to lead the industry in program management and service delivery.


  Role Summary


 The AI/ML Engineer serves in a part-time, 1099 independent contractor capacity and is responsible for designing, developing, and deploying machine learning models and artificial intelligence solutions that drive Steel Point's data-driven initiatives. This role involves creating algorithms, working with large datasets, and implementing AI/ML solutions to solve complex business challenges. The AI/ML Engineer will collaborate with data scientists, software engineers, and other stakeholders to integrate, optimize, and scale AI/ML systems within existing infrastructure.


 

 


  Key Roles & Responsibilities
